method: Pictures first: rendered the whole box (part_overview.png, --grid 1 --inserts) and a wall-fill version (fill_overview.png: A-WALL / A-WALL-PATT / S-COLS hatches filled), then walked the part in zoomed tiles of about 6 x 5.5 m at 0.5 m grid with insert names (tA1-A3 y -36.8..-31; tB1, tB1b, tB2, tB3 y -42.5..-34.8; tC1-C3 y -46.5..-41; tD1-D3 y -51.5..-46; tE1-E3 y -56..-50; tF1-F4 y -61..-55), following every wall line. Every candidate was then confirmed from prims.pkl: wall hatch polygons and A-WALL lines at the wall ends on both sides, door block insert point / rotation / frame lines / leaf and swing arcs, Door-Opening family rectangles, stall blocks (posts and 45 deg leaf lines). a/b are the wall-end faces on the wall centre line (verified with a shapely union of the wall hatches: gap free of wall material, both ends on wall faces). Cross-checks: (1) all door inserts at any depth in the box (top-level A-DOOR inserts and the link blocks D36, D37, D_Openning_Lift, D_Swing_Single, Door NO_03, Door NO_17) are listed; (2) all door swing arcs in the box belong to a listed door; (3) an automatic wall-end ray cast over the hatch union found the same end-to-end gaps plus the two corridor mouths; (4) un-hatched A-WALL lines were checked for line-only walls and gaps; (5) final render with a marker at every listed centre (marks_final.png) showed no unmarked swing, leaf, track or gap. Conventions used: lift landing doors with leaves = door, lift opening without leaf = passage (optional), cubicle doors = optional doors, doors in the 10 mm screens/curtain panels = host glass.
